Quadruple (0): what goes in the res column?
In a quadruple, the result has a name: %1$s goes in the res column.
Quadruple (%1$s), the copy: what goes in arg1?
The copy has op =, the value %1$s in arg1 and the variable in res. arg2 stays empty.
Triple (%1$s): what goes in place of %2$s?
In a triple, the result has no name. Whoever uses %1$s points to the line that computed it: %2$s.
Triple (%1$s), the copy: what goes in arg2?
The copy becomes = %1$s %2$s: the variable and the line of the value.
